prop_target.firm: Crypto Fund Trader (rules UNCERTAIN: cryptofundtrader.com search extracts + user message)

2PHASE.basis: equity; daily vs balance at 00:05 UTC

1PHASE.max_loss: 0.06 trailing from peak balance, stops at initial balance

costs.base: 7.5 bp per unit turnover (Bybit taker 5.5 bp + 2 bp slippage per side); funding: actual Binance BTC/ETH 2020-2023 & 2025-26 where available, else 1 bp per 8h paid by longs / received by shorts

datasets.MULTI_CLOSE: Coin Metrics community PriceUSD + CapMrktCurUSD, point-in-time top-10 non-stablecoin assets by market cap (>= 200 days history), close-only, equal risk. DEV 2017-07..2020-12, VAL 2021-01..2022-12, TEST 2023-01..2026-05 (time-series strategies never run on alts in TEST; BTC/ETH paths previously seen)

sizing: each asset: signal in [-1,1] x (0.40 / 30-day realised vol), capped at 1x; multi-asset: average over universe members; decided at close t, earns close t -> t+1

Z06_BOLLINGER_BREAKOUT.note: enter outside band, exit at middle

Z07_BOLLINGER_REVERSION.note: fade outside band, exit at middle

Z08_RSI_REVERSION.note: RSI2 variant requires close > SMA200 for longs (Connors)

Z11_ZSCORE_REVERSION.note: fade 5-day return z-score beyond 1.5, hold 3 days

Z15_DUAL_MOMENTUM_ROTATION.note: MULTI only: hold the top-3 30/90-day performers if their momentum > 0, else cash

Z19_ORB_UTC.dataset: BTC 1h only: break of the 00:00-04:00 UTC range, exit at 24:00 UTC

gates (all required for 'edge found').DEV: net Sharpe >= 1.0 AND residual Sharpe vs buy&hold-VT >= 0.5 AND >= 2/3 of the same strategy's other configs with DEV net Sharpe > 0
gates (all required for 'edge found').TEST: net Sharpe >= 0.6 AND net Sharpe >= 0.4 at 2x costs
gates (all required for 'edge found').selection_bias: Deflated Sharpe Ratio on DEV+VAL with N = total zoo configurations >= 0.90; CSCV PBO over all configs on DEV+VAL reported
gates (all required for 'edge found').prop: Crypto Fund Trader 2-Phase simulated pass (both phases) >= 60% with daily-loss breaches <= 10%, risk level chosen on DEV+VAL only

statuses: 'EDGE FOUND' only if every gate passes; otherwise the strongest configuration is reported with the gates it failed
